entities.label: SPRUJ26A
entities.description: Motor Control SDK Universal Project and Lab User's Guide (Rev. A, September 2021, revised April 2024).
aliases: Universal Motor Control Project and Lab User's Guide

entities.label: Universal Motor Control Lab
entities.description: Universal motor control lab project in MotorControl SDK, evaluated on C2000 LaunchPads or controlCARDs with motor drive evaluation boards.

entities.label: MotorControl SDK
entities.description: TI SDK that supports the listed motor drive evaluation kits for the universal lab.

entities.label: C2000Ware
entities.description: Holds LaunchPad and controlCARD hardware files under <install_location>\boards.

entities.label: Code Composer Studio
entities.description: IDE to download as Step 3 of getting started.

entities.label: InstaSPIN-FOC
entities.description: Sensorless algorithm; the inverter boards are suitable for use with it. Run during flying start to estimate real speed.

entities.label: SFRA
entities.description: Software frequency response analyzer; uses XDS110 virtual COM port on LaunchPads.

entities.label: user_mtr1.h
entities.description: Header file defining motor user constants such as USER_MOTOR1_NUM_ENC_SLOTS.

entities.label: TI C2000 E2E forum
entities.description: Forum for searching or asking design questions (Step 5).

entities.label: Flying start
entities.description: Routine disables speed closed loop, sets Iq reference to zero, enables FOC/InstaSPIN estimator to estimate real motor speed, then re-enables speed control.

entities.label: FOC
entities.description: Field-oriented control.

entities.label: Speed_fs_min
entities.description: Minimum speed threshold in the flying start flowchart; if Speed_est is below it, Speed_int is set to 0, else Speed_int=Speed_est.

entities.label: Speed_est
entities.description: Estimated speed read during flying start.

entities.label: C2000
entities.description: TI C2000 real-time microcontroller family.

entities.label: F28002x
entities.description: TMS320F28002x C2000 MCU series with IEEE 754 FPU and TMU.

entities.label: F28003x
entities.description: TMS320F28003x C2000 MCU series with IEEE 754 FPU and TMU.

entities.label: F280013x
entities.description: TMS320F280013x C2000 MCU series with IEEE 754 FPU and TMU.

entities.label: F280025C
entities.description: C2000 MCU (U1) on LAUNCHXL-F280025C and TMDSCNCD280025C.

entities.label: F280039C
entities.description: C2000 MCU (U1) on LAUNCHXL-F280039C and TMDSCNCD280039C.

entities.label: F2800137
entities.description: C2000 MCU (U1) on LAUNCHXL-F2800137 and TMDSCNCD2800137.

entities.label: FPU
entities.description: IEEE 754 Floating-Point Unit.

entities.label: TMU
entities.description: Trigonometric Math Unit.

entities.label: eQEP
entities.description: Enhanced QEP; eQEP1 used for encoder interface J12, eQEP2 for Hall sensor interface J13.

entities.label: CAN
entities.description: CAN interface routed to transceiver/J14 when CMD_CAN_EN is set.

entities.label: SPI
entities.description: SPI used to configure DRV gate drivers; SPIA-STE connected to DRV nSCS.

entities.label: SCI
entities.description: UART routed to XDS110 virtual COM port.

entities.label: FSI
entities.description: FSI header J1 on controlCARDs.

entities.label: ADC
entities.description: ADC with VREFHI reference selection (internal/external) on controlCARDs.

entities.label: ePWM
entities.description: PWM outputs low-pass filtered as PWMDAC on [Main]-J14 of TMDSHVMTRINSPIN.

entities.label: CMD_CAN_EN
entities.description: Pre-defined project symbol enabling CAN; S4 switch routes CAN GPIOs to J14.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_NUM_ENC_SLOTS
entities.description: Number of encoder slots per rotation (not quadrature counts); wrong value makes motor spin faster or slower.

entities.label: ENC module
entities.description: Lab module converting encoder signal into an angle; requires slots per rotation.

entities.label: Encoder
entities.description: QEP encoder; A-A, B-B, I-I wiring required, often +5V and ground.

entities.label: Hall sensor
entities.description: Hall sensors; A-A, B-B, C-C wiring required.

entities.label: XDS110 debugger
entities.description: On-board debugger with virtual COM port on LaunchPads and controlCARDs.

entities.label: XDS100v2 emulator
entities.description: On-card emulator on TMDSCNCD280025C; XDS100 also on TMDSHVMTRINSPIN.

entities.label: HSEC180 connector
entities.description: 180-pin High Speed Edge Connector of controlCARDs.

entities.label: DIMM100 connector
entities.description: 100-pin DIMM controlCARD socket used by existing evaluation tools such as TMDSHVMTRINSPIN.

entities.label: LAUNCHXL-F280025C
entities.description: Low-cost development board for F28002x devices; supports two BoosterPack plug-in modules.

properties.form_factor: LaunchPad, two BoosterPack sites (site 1 J1-J4, site 2 J5-J8)
properties.jumpers: JP1, JP2, JP3, J101 installed; JP8 for DAC128S board
properties.S2: SEL1 UP: GPIO28/29 to BoosterPack; SEL2 UP: GPIO16/17 to XDS110 virtual COM
properties.S3: GPIO24 DOWN (0), GPIO32 UP (1): wait boot mode
properties.S4: DOWN: GPIO32/33 to CAN transceiver J14 if CMD_CAN_EN
properties.S5: QEP1 DOWN: GPIO44/37/43 to eQEP1 J12 encoder; QEP2 DOWN: GPIO14/25/26 to eQEP2 J13 Hall

entities.label: LAUNCHXL-F280039C
entities.description: Low-cost development board for F28003x devices; supports two BoosterPack plug-in modules.
aliases: C2000 F28003x Series LaunchPad Development Kit

properties.jumpers: JP1, JP2, J101 installed; JP8 for DAC128S board
properties.S2: SEL1 UP: GPIO28/29 to BoosterPack; SEL2 UP: GPIO15/56 to XDS110 virtual COM
properties.S3: GPIO24 DOWN (0), GPIO32 UP (1): wait boot mode
properties.S4: DOWN: GPIO4/5 to CAN J14 if CMD_CAN_EN; UP: to BoosterPack
properties.S5: QEP1 DOWN: GPIO40/41/59 to eQEP1 J12 encoder; QEP2 DOWN: GPIO14/55/57 to eQEP2 J13 Hall

entities.label: LAUNCHXL-F2800137
entities.description: Low-cost development board for F280013x devices; supports two BoosterPack plug-in modules.
aliases: C2000 F2800137 Series LaunchPad Development Kit

properties.jumpers: JP1, JP2, J101 installed; JP8 for DAC128S board
properties.S2: SEL1 UP: GPIO28/29 to BoosterPack; SEL1 DOWN for SFRA via XDS110 COM (only with BOOSTXL-3PHGANINV; other kits need GPIO29 to enable DRV)
properties.S3: GPIO24 DOWN (0), GPIO32 UP (1): wait boot mode
properties.S4: CAN ROUTE DOWN: GPIO4/5 to J14 if CMD_CAN_EN; UP: to BoosterPack
properties.S5: QEP1 DOWN: GPIO40/41/39 to eQEP1 J12
properties.hall_connector: none (no J13); Hall reading unavailable by default

entities.label: Wait boot mode
entities.description: Boot mode set by GPIO24=0 and GPIO32=1, reducing risk of connectivity issues or execution of previously loaded code.

entities.label: TMDSCNCD280025C
entities.description: Low-cost evaluation board (controlCARD) for F28002X devices with HSEC180 connector; used on TMDSHVMTRINSPIN via TMDSADAP180TO100.

properties.S1:A: SEL1 and SEL2 UP: on-card XDS100v2 emulator and ISO UART
properties.S4: SEL1 DOWN GPIO24=0, SEL2 UP GPIO32=1: wait boot mode
properties.S5: SEL1 DOWN: A8/C11 to HSEC pin 30; SEL2 UP: internal voltage reference

entities.label: TMDSCNCD280039C
entities.description: Low-cost evaluation board (controlCARD) for F28003X devices with HSEC180 connector; used on TMDSHVMTRINSPIN via TMDSADAP180TO100.

properties.S1:A: SEL1 and SEL2 LEFT: on-card XDS110 emulator and ISO UART
properties.S2: SEL1 DOWN GPIO24=0, SEL2 UP GPIO32=1: wait boot mode

entities.label: TMDSCNCD2800137
entities.description: Low-cost evaluation board (controlCARD) for F280013X devices with HSEC180 connector; used on TMDSHVMTRINSPIN via TMDSADAP180TO100.

properties.S1:A: SEL1 and SEL2 LEFT: on-card XDS110 emulator and ISO UART
properties.S3: SEL1 DOWN GPIO24=0, SEL2 UP GPIO32=1: wait boot mode
properties.S4: SEL1 DOWN: A8/C11 to HSEC pin 30; SEL2 UP: internal voltage reference

entities.label: TMDSADAP180TO100
entities.description: Adapter allowing 180-pin C2000 controlCARDs to be used with existing 100-pin DIMM based evaluation tools.

entities.label: PMSM
entities.description: Permanent magnet synchronous motor.

entities.label: BLDC
entities.description: Brushless DC motor.

entities.label: ACIM
entities.description: AC induction motor (ACI).

entities.label: LVSERVOMTR
entities.description: Low-voltage servo motor with embedded encoder; tested with low-voltage inverter boards.

properties.encoder_wiring: GND BLACK J4-1, +5V RED J4-2, I BROWN J4-3, B ORANGE J4-4, A BLUE
properties.hall_wiring: GND BLACK J10-1, +5V RED J10-2, A GRAY-WHITE J10-3, B GREEN-WHITE J10-4, C GREEN J10-5

entities.label: LVBLDCMTR
entities.description: Low-voltage BLDC motor with embedded Hall sensors; not supported for encoder-based sensored FOC.

properties.hall_wiring: GND BLACK, +5V RED, A BLUE, B GREEN, C WHITE

entities.label: HVPMSMMTR
entities.description: High-voltage PMSM with embedded encoder; tested with TMDSHVMTRINSPIN; not supported for Hall-based sensored FOC.

properties.encoder_wiring: GND BLACK, +5V RED, I YELLOW, B GREEN, A BLUE

entities.label: HVBLDCMTR
entities.description: High-voltage BLDC motor with embedded Hall sensors; not supported for encoder-based sensored FOC.

properties.hall_wiring: GND BLACK, +5V RED, A BLUE, B GREEN, C WHITE

entities.label: FAST estimator
entities.description: FAST estimator based sensorless-FOC rotor position sensing.

entities.label: eSMO
entities.description: eSMO observer based sensorless-FOC.

entities.label: Sensorless FOC
entities.description: Sensorless field-oriented control via FAST or eSMO.

entities.label: Sensored FOC
entities.description: QEP encoder or Hall sensor based sensored-FOC; requires correct wiring order.

entities.label: Sensorless trapezoidal control
entities.description: Sensorless trapezoidal control listed for DRV8329AEVM.

entities.label: Single shunt dc-link current sensing
entities.description: Current sensing topology using one dc-link shunt.

entities.label: Three low-side current shunt sensing
entities.description: Current sensing using three low-side shunts and amplifiers.

entities.label: In-line phase current shunt sensing
entities.description: Three shunt-based in-line motor phase current sensing.

entities.label: Integrated current-sense amplifiers
entities.description: CSAs integrated in the driver for three-phase low-side current measurement.

entities.label: DC bus and three-phase voltage sensing
entities.description: Individual DC bus and three-phase voltage sensing on the inverter module.

entities.label: Short circuit protection
entities.description: Drive stage protection against short circuit (with thermal, shoot-through and undervoltage).

entities.label: Thermal protection
entities.description: Drive-stage thermal protection.

entities.label: Shoot-through protection
entities.description: Drive-stage shoot-through protection.

entities.label: Undervoltage protection
entities.description: Drive-stage undervoltage protection.

entities.label: Overcurrent protection
entities.description: IPM over current protection on TMDSHVMTRINSPIN, enabled by [Main]-J8 with threshold selected by J7/VR1.

entities.label: DRV8329A
entities.description: Gate driver on DRV8329AEVM.

entities.label: CSD18536KT
entities.description: NexFET MOSFET on DRV8329AEVM (Table 3-1 lists CSD18536KTTT).

entities.label: DRV8323RH
entities.description: Gate driver on BOOSTXL-DRV8323RH (hardware-configured).

entities.label: DRV8323RS
entities.description: SPI gate driver on BOOSTXL-DRV8323RS with IDRIVE configuration and fault pin; ABS max supply 65 V.

entities.label: CSD88599Q5DC
entities.description: NexFET power block used on BOOSTXL-DRV8323RH/RS.

entities.label: DRV8353RS
entities.description: SPI-configurable gate driver on DRV8353RS-EVM.

entities.label: CSD19532Q5B
entities.description: NexFET power block used on DRV8353RS-EVM.

entities.label: DRV8316
entities.description: Driver with three integrated half-H-bridge MOSFETs and integrated CSAs, 8-A peak.

entities.label: GaN power stage
entities.description: Three-phase GaN inverter power stage on BOOSTXL-3PHGANINV.

entities.label: IPM
entities.description: Intelligent power module on TMDSHVMTRINSPIN with heat sink and DC fan.

entities.label: PFC stage
entities.description: Power factor correction stage on TMDSHVMTRINSPIN (750W max); bypassed with BS1-BS5 banana cable.

entities.label: Aux power supply module
entities.description: TMDSHVMTRINSPIN aux supply sourcing from bridge or PFC output per [Main]-J2.

entities.label: DRV8329AEVM
entities.description: 4.5-60V, 30-A three-phase BLDC drive stage based on DRV8329A gate driver and CSD18536KT MOSFET, with DC bus/three-phase voltage sensing and single-shunt dc-link current amplifiers.

properties.mount: on top of LaunchPad via male-to-female adapters
properties.setup: bend LaunchPad J5-42 if using DAC128S085EVM

entities.label: BOOSTXL-DRV8323RH
entities.description: 15-A three-phase BLDC drive stage based on DRV8323RH gate driver and CSD88599Q5DC NexFET power blocks, with three low-side current shunt amplifiers and voltage sensing.

properties.setup: populate C9, C10, C11 with 47nF; bend LaunchPad J3-29/J3-30; optional jumper J3-29 (LaunchPad) to J3-11 (BoosterPack) for potentiometer speed reference; bend J5-42 if DAC128S085EVM

entities.label: BOOSTXL-DRV8323RS
entities.description: 15-A three-phase BLDC drive stage based on DRV8323RS gate driver and CSD88599Q5DC NexFET power blocks, with three low-side current shunt amplifiers, IDRIVE and SPI-configurable protection.

properties.setup: populate C9-C11 47nF; bend J3-29/J3-30 and J2-12; jumper J4-18(nSCS/GAIN) to J4-4 (F280025C/39C) or J4-16 (F2800137) for SPIA-STE; optional J3-29 to J3-11 for potentiometer

entities.label: DRV8353RS-EVM
entities.description: 15-A three-phase BLDC drive stage based on DRV8353RS gate driver and CSD19532Q5B NexFET power blocks, with three low-side current shunt amplifiers and SPI-configurable protection.

properties.mount: bottom of LaunchPad via male-to-male adapters; disconnect J1-17 and J1-19
properties.setup: do not connect J3-29/J3-30; jumper J2-19 to J2-12 (F280025C/39C) or J2-13 to J2-12 (F2800137) for SPI-STE

entities.label: BOOSTXL-3PHGANINV
entities.description: 48-V/10-A three-phase GaN inverter with precision in-line shunt-based phase current sensing and DC bus/three-phase voltage sensing.

entities.label: DRV8316REVM
entities.description: Three half-H-bridge integrated MOSFET driver board for three-phase BLDC motors, 8-A peak, with integrated CSAs and voltage sensing.

entities.label: Servo drives
entities.description: Precision drives targeted by BOOSTXL-3PHGANINV.

entities.label: DAC128S085EVM
entities.description: Optional DAC board on LaunchPad site 2 (J5-J8) used only for debugging to monitor software variables; requires bending J5-42 and JA-2 to JB-2 jumper.

properties.site: LaunchPad J5/J7 and J6/J8; JP8 jumpers power it

entities.label: TMDSHVMTRINSPIN
entities.description: DIMM100 controlCARD based high voltage motor control kit for ACI, BLDC and PMSM motors with DC bus and three-phase voltage sensing and three low-side current shunts.

properties.pfc: 750W max, bypassed with BS1-BS5 banana cable
properties.jumpers: [Main]-J3, J4, J5, J8 populated; J9 and [M3]-J5 not populated (use controlCARD emulation); J7 on pins 2-3
properties.dc_power: recommended external 15V DC to [M6]-JP1 with [Main]-J2 unpopulated
